prompt_text: Tax the rich.
final_text: It’s a popular idea, one that Democratic Presidential candidates like Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.) and Mayor Pete Buttigieg have promoted this cycle, as well as a handful of progressive groups and organizations. And a new poll conducted by the Pew Research Center found that an overwhelming majority of Americans support higher taxes on those earning over $400,000 per year. This would include households in the top 2% of income earners, which encompasses most Fortune 500 CEOs, private equity magnates, Wall Street financiers, and Silicon Valley entrepreneurs—all of whom have made fortunes over the past two decades while wage growth for everyone else was stagnant and income inequality grew at alarming rates.
